notes.title: Serious Bugfixes & Balance update
notes.notes:
Hey heroes!
After it's been a hot minute (1 month!) but we've noticed a number of serious bugs in the game that were introduced in the Ninja DLC. So we're put together a mega update with not only a ton of serious bug fixes, but also a number of huge balance changes to bonus objectives, missions and overall gameplay!

This update should make the overall experience feel much smoother, and less unfairly difficult at times.

v1.26
Additions
- Added 5 new Legendary outfits based on Community member AniArtistMe for his incredible bug spotting!

Fixes
- Hero Select & Shop no longer behave strangely on first load
- Prototype mission rewards no longer softlock the game in rare situations
- Tear Gas now properly works on the Missile & Speeding Train maps
- Kevlar Vests now properly works in FFA/Solo type games
- Wrath of the Tiger properly gives -25% damage taken instead of -75%
- Disabling Passives/Abilities/Gadgets in custom mode now works as expected
- Setting specific weapons allowed in custom mode now works as expected
- Fixed a rare bug where switching classes in a FFA mode will put you on blue team
- Unique characters (Riggs, Bull, Toad, etc) now have their proper class & loadout again
- Winning/Losing a match will always display the correct winning score
- Bayonet's execute now works as expected
- BoStaff no longer has a damage delay when attacking
- Adjusted AI jumps on  Hijack, Missile, Crash, and Foundry
- The volume of rocket trails are now adjusted by Sound Volume
- Fixed a few spelling/text issues in game and menus

Balance
(Gameplay)
- Adjusted many Bonus objectives in missions to make them more easily obtainable
- At the results screen, deaths are now only -3 points instead of -5
- Challenge mission "Self Experiments" & Alt versions has 1 less enemy
- Ninja will show up as a random enemy/ally 25% less often to avoid Melee spam
- Lowered enemy Hp by 10% on gungame (since you can't use your own gear)
- In Juggernaut, the Juggernaut can no longer gain extra armor (same as heals)
- Kevlar Vest ability now gives +30% more armor
- Kevlar Vest armor is capped for enemies above lvl 30
- Pheonix blade removed from all enemies in SideOps 8, 8-1, 8-2
- Challenge 6-2: Health reduced, Enemies reduced by 1
- Challenge 8-1: +40% Health
- Challenge 10 & Alt versions: you have faster drone charge rate while enemies are slower.
- Challenge 10-1: Enemies deal -20% damage
- Your own weapons sounds are only 10% quieter instead of 20% quieter
- Melee Enemies attack slightly slower
- Melee Enemies now do much less damage (even less at lower levels)

(Menus)
- Gadgets appear in the shop ~15% less frequently

(Ninja Weapons)
- Kunai: FireRate -20%, Impact -10%
- Healing Salve: Ammo -4, FireRate -10%
- Baseball: ProjectileSpeed +15%, Range +10%, Accuracy +10%
- Spikeball: Range +10%
- Rock: FireRate +15%, ProjectileSpeed +10%
- Bostaff: DashDistance -66%, FireRate -10%, Impact +10%
- Nunchucks: Dash Removed, FireRate +5%, Impact -20%, Range -5%
- Chakram: Range/Duration +15%

(Other Weapons)
- M202: SpareClips +2
- ALL Melee weapon Impact +10%


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42755219/1900f8bf3da3c1a650332c5a1c23137548d12b0c.png

As always, thanks for sticking around as we continue to fix & improve the game!

<3 Justin & Mike

notes.title: v1.22 Mini Update (Hacker fix)
notes.notes:
While the game was meant to be played among friends, the party list makes it possible to play with strangers, however lately many players have been hacking their game to get items they shouldn't have,

This mini update addresses many of those issues by removing items that players should normally not be able to obtain.

The full rundown are below!

v1.22
- Removes skills being used from other classes they don't belong to
- Removes boss/challenge weapons from players inventories
- Changes unreleased DLC classes back to normal class
- Removes unreleased DLC items from players inventories
- Removes outfits that players do not own (DLC/Kickstarter/etc)
- Plus a few other minor changes to reduce hacking.

And as always, I'll continue to monitor and make adjustments as the game needs!

<3 Sky9 Games

notes.title: Strike Force Heroes Huge XP Update + Survey
notes.notes:
Thank you all for actively providing feedback on the game since its release. We're hard at work updating the game and are rolling out the biggest change yet! The XP system has been significantly altered to allow lower level players the ability to level up much faster against higher level enemies in addition to teammates sharing a portion of XP from kills. We know that a number of players have expressed concerns about the game's difficulty being too high and so we have altered the difficulty of some of the maps, added some much needed ammo and health pickups, and enhanced the XP given from certain enemies.

In addition to that, we have created a difficulty survey and hope that you can take 5 minutes to fill it out as your feedback will help shape the game!

Survey Link: https://forms.gle/6L3jALz3vARrAJQ6A

Thank you for your support!

<3 Justin & Mike

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions Before Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42755219/5d10cd5abd2e0a4760848d8aef56d74469340bd1.png

Heya Heroes! 

With less than 24 hours from release! We're all super excited and ready to smash some GlobeX.

We're also thrown together this handy dandy FAQ.

F.A.Q.

Q: When will Strike Force Heroes be released?
In less than 24 hours, duh!
But more specifically: Nov 10, 2023, at 4 AM PST.

Q: What is the cost?
$19.99 USD, with a 10% discount for the first week, bringing the discounted price down to $17.99. As for other regions:


 Euros: Discounted price €17.55
 Russian Rubles: Discounted price ₽675
 Japanese Yen: Discounted price ¥2,070
 Korean Won: Discounted price ₩19,350


You can also pick up the Delux Edition, featuring  the complete game, full digital soundtrack, and a digital art book -- All for $26.97 (also discounted).

Q: Where can you play it?
SFH is currently available only on Steam, with other Consoles to follow.

Q: What has changed from the original Flash game?
Oh boy, this is a big one! It's been completely redone as it's own standalone game, with a huge expanded story, fully animated cutscenes, online multiplayer, 3x more challenge missions, daily missions, a full loot system *pauses a moment to breathe*, gadgets, custom modes, feats, etc. You get the idea!

Q: What are the minimum game specs?
MINIMUM:
OS: Windows 10
Processor: intel i3-2100/AMD-5600k or better
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 600 series/ Radeon HD 7000 series or better
Storage: 2 GB available space

However there are a number of graphical options available.

Q: How is the Controller Support?
The game is can be fully controlled via Mouse'n'Keyboard or Controller, and both have full button remapping in the settings.

Strike Force Heroes is awesome!
Not really a question, but thankyou.

Q: How does online work?
Simple! Create or Join a party, select -ANY- mission or mode, and dive in, that's it! There are no restrictions on what you can or can't do online.. This includes player limit, play with up to 256 players as long as your computer can handle it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981820/_Strike_Force_Heroes/

<3 Sky9 Games

notes.title: Strike Force Heroes Release Date!
notes.notes:
We're excited to finally be able to share with you the official release date for Strike Force Heroes: October 19th, 2023! 

[previewyoutube=ngthqLrI2gM;full][/previewyoutube]

Strike Force Heroes will be available on PC and feature a completely rewritten campaign with full voice acting, animated cutscenes, and side missions, so whether you're a long time fan or totally new to the series, there will plenty of surprises in store. Challenge missions with special variations also make a return: hone your skills across dozens of crazy missions featuring special objectives, abilities, weapons and more! 

And once you're ready for the ultimate test, play online in intense PvP matches or play co-operatively in any of the game modes!


 Level up four classes each with their own weapons and abilities to unlock.
 Experiment with over 60 weapons and an all new loot system
 Refine your experience with passive skills, awesome gadgets, and powerful abilities
 Experience a brand new campaign with an epic story, memorable characters, and intense boss battles
 Play though dozens of missions with unique objectives and a new ranking system
 Head online for PvP and co-operative play across the campaign, challenges, and custom games


Thank you so much for supporting Strike Force Heroes, this game is truly a labor of love and a love letter to the Flash games we grew up with and we can't wait for you all to play it! We're heading to Gamescom where we'll be showing the game off in-person for hands-on play and we'll be releasing an updated demo. As always, your feedback is greatly appreciated!

<3 Mike and Justin

notes.title: v0.27 - HUGE Bugfix update!
notes.notes:
Last patch a pretty nasty bug snuck in that basically broke the game for everyone. (Sorry!)

Today there's not only a fix for that, but metric buttload of other fixes and additions!

Additions
- Shop gains a new item after a completed mission (after 12 items, the oldest is removed)
- Buckler shields now reduce recoil by 25% while blocking.
- Legionary shields now have a 15% chance to reflect projectiles while blocking.
- Riot shields now crouch-walk faster while blocking.

Fixes
- Fixed the settings glitch that broke the game if it was played in the previous version (big oops!)
- Gadgets properly show effect % based on their level.
- Can no longer get money back from failed Slot Machine Rolls by reloading the game.
- Mission Specific weapons (Ex: Golden Gun) now properly display their names in game.
- Shields now properly reduce damage by the amount specified.
- Fixed a few minor spelling errors.
- Gadgets can now be properly unequipped.
- Fixed players going above the Demos Hero Lvl 4 limit (again) & also fixed weapons that are above that limit.
- Equipping the Bipod no longer allows you to crouch in mid-air for super accuracy.
- You no longer get kills/score by killing yourself or allies.
- The kill sound effect is no longer played when killing yourself or allies.
- Switching to a class without a weapon equipped no longer keeps some of the the previous weapon's stats.
- AI no longer uses abilities from the wrong class.

Balance
- Tactical Reload reduced from 50% > 30%
- Reduced melee weapon dash distance by 33%
- Increased Fal damage by ~10%

Thanks for your patience, we'll continue to drop more updates as often as possible!

notes.title: v0.26 - Demo bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Thanks for trying out the (very work in progress) demo and bearing with the bugs it may have had!

While we're still hard at work at the game, we'll continue to patch the bugs out of the demo until it's squeaky clean!

This first patch tackles the big ones, save corruption, broken resolution, and extra graphics options.
Below is a full rundown of the patch:

v0.26 Fixes:
- Bipod now correctly improves accuracy
- Having a previous (early) save of the game no longer breaks the menu
- Fixed rare occurance of heroes equipping a non-existant weapon that breaks the game
- Resolution now properly saves
- Max level should properly be set to 4 for the demo
- Added 2 new graphics options for slower computers
- Crash map no longer has random grey cubes
- Jenkins can no longer be damaged before the fight begins

More to come soon!
